subject: assets
title: M4 exit set: 33 graveyard props by a swarm
note: The M4 exit proof's batch: 33 map-1 graveyard props written as procedural recipes by four builder agents (CSG, SDF sculpts, lathes, sweeps), checked against style.toml and the studio's taste checks, reviewed by an art-director agent (four critiques fixed: the mourner and the skull marker read too close to the obelisk and the urn, the candles and bone pile too small on a phone), watched by a debugger agent. One contact sheet (three-quarter under the game's moonlight, the gameplay shot at true pixel size) waits on the owner's review screen; gallery rounds hold three look decisions.
